emergingTech.population: First 60 API search results, not a systematic review; retrieval order retained.
emergingTech.transform: Up to three provider-assigned topics per paper; bipartite paper-topic edges are classifications, not citations or verified NLP triples.

heritage.provider: NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission / NYC Open Data
heritage.transform: Filter DESIGNATED + Individual Landmark. Deduplicate lp_number; first valid building coordinate retained; retain buildingRecords count. Designation date is not construction date or community value.
heritage.license: Public NYC Open Data metadata; governed by NYC Open Data Terms of Use, not a blanket CC0 claim. No photographs copied.
heritage.boundary: Administrative designations reflect institutional selection, not the full universe of cultural heritage. NYC observations do not establish Jinxi community needs.

earth.unit: Dated event geometry, not unique event or people affected
earth.transform: Reuse documented closed-event category snapshots from the Week 4 notebook; not a complete hazard census.
earth.boundary: Source coverage and event definition vary; absence is not safety and point count is not impact.

world.license: Natural Earth public domain; simplified cartography for context, not boundary adjudication.
